Method of Attack: Malicious DLL replacement in legitimate IObit License Manager software to install ransomware
Adds Windows autorun to execute ransomware DLL on login
Adds Windows Defender exclusions to evade detection
Encrypts files appending .DeroHE extension and ransom note
Uses fake email promotion with malicious download link hosted on compromised IObit forum
Impacted Systems: Windows systems running IObit software and members of IObit forums
Attack Vector: Compromised IObit forum with malicious script injection and administrative access
Phishing emails with malicious download link to free license promotion
Execution of malicious IObitUnlocker.dll replacing legitimate DLL
Indicators of Compromise: Windows Defender exclusions added via WMIC commands
Fake email claiming free 1-year license from IObit
